headline: Udawalawe: Open Grasslands, Elephant Herds & the Elephant Transit Home
description:
Udawalawe’s grasslands and scrub surround a large reservoir, and its resident elephant herds are seen on almost every drive. Water buffalo, crocodiles, eagles and the occasional leopard complete the picture.

It is my favourite first safari for families: short, gentle drives, elephants close by, and a visit to the Elephant Transit Home, where orphaned calves are fed and prepared for life back in the wild — with no riding and no touching.

guideNote.heading: An Easy Win for Young Travellers
paragraphs: Children remember Udawalawe for ever: a mother elephant dust-bathing beside the jeep, calves chasing each other through the grass. I give young guests binoculars and a field notebook so they can become the expedition’s official naturalists.

experiences.title: Private Jeep Safari on the Open Grasslands
experiences.text: Herds grazing in the soft morning light, the reservoir glinting behind them, and a naturalist who knows the matriarchs by sight.

experiences.title: The Elephant Transit Home
experiences.text: Watch orphaned calves arrive for their milk feeds from a viewing platform — a conservation programme that has returned many elephants to the wild.

image.alt: Family walking beside an elephant mother and calf in an Udawalawe sanctuary

fieldNotes.title: Feeding Times
fieldNotes.text: The Transit Home feeds the calves at set times through the day. I plan the drive so that we arrive a few minutes early.

fieldNotes.title: No Riding, Ever
fieldNotes.text: I never include elephant rides or bathing attractions. Seeing elephants wild and free is the far greater privilege.

fieldNotes.title: Dust & Sun
fieldNotes.text: Open jeeps are dusty in the dry months. Bring sunglasses, a hat and a light scarf; I carry wet towels and water.

tours.title: Wild Leopards & Untamed Coastlines
tours.summary: Immersive expedition for wildlife photographers and conservation enthusiasts. Private trackers, custom open-sided 4x4 safaris, and private coastal yacht charters for sperm and blue whale sightings.

cover.alt: Open-top safari jeep watching a leopard on a granite boulder in Yala

tours.title: Ceylon Family Wonder & Discovery
tours.summary: Eleven gentle days built around children and grandparents alike: wild elephants from the safari jeep, a village day by bullock cart and canoe, junior naturalist kits, a turtle hatchery and safe surf and kayak sessions on the west coast.
